items.name: decipher
items.title: Decipher
items.description: Text scramble/reveal effect. Final text stays in the accessibility tree; the glyph layer is aria-hidden, per-script glyph pools, flicker capped at MAX_FLASH_HZ, instant under reduced/off motion.
items.docs:
Unofficial fan project. Runs once on mount and whenever `text` changes; `trigger="inview"` runs once when first visible (idle before). Reads data-motion on <html>: reduced/off renders the final text synchronously. Also ships `Glitch` (one-shot RGB channel-split on display text, string only, `replay()` ref handle, 1 s lockout).

Migration (v4): Decipher gained `trigger` and `data-state` (idle | running | done); no prop was removed. Glitch is new: use it for system-fault display text only, never on text the user reads or types.
